##Dialysis data

The following files were downloaded and unzipped from <https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/archived-data/dialysis-facilities> <https://wayback.archive-it.org/all/20160104132404/https://data.medicare.gov/data/archives/dialysis-facility-compare>

```{r uploaddialysisdata}


#Create list of files
File_List_csv_raw<-list.files(path=".", pattern="csv", recursive = TRUE)
File_List_txt_raw<-list.files(path=".", pattern="txt", recursive = TRUE)

#List raw csv files
File_List_csv_raw%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  flextable()

#List raw tab files
File_List_txt_raw%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  flextable()

#Create a file with all facility level CSV file names
File_List_csv_clean<-tibble(File_List_csv_raw)%>%
  filter(!str_detect(File_List_csv_raw, "ICH"))%>%
  filter(str_detect(File_List_csv_raw, "FAC"))%>%
  rename(FileName=File_List_csv_raw)

#Create a file with all facility level txt file names
File_List_txt_clean<-tibble(File_List_txt_raw)%>%
  filter(!str_detect(File_List_txt_raw, "readme"))%>%
  rename(FileName=File_List_txt_raw)

#Define input function for CSV
dialysis_read_csv<-function(x) {
read_csv(x, col_types = cols(Zip = col_character()),
         locale=locale(encoding="latin1"))%>%
    rename_with(toupper)%>%
    rename(TOTSTAS='# OF DIALYSIS STATIONS')%>%
    rename_with(~case_when(
      .=="PROFIT OR NON-PROFIT"~"PROFIT_STATUS",
      .=="PROFIT OR NON-PROFIT?"~"PROFIT_STATUS",
      TRUE~.
    ))%>%
    select(ZIP, TOTSTAS, PROFIT_STATUS)%>%
    mutate(ZIP=case_when(
      str_length(ZIP)==5~ZIP,
      str_length(ZIP)==4~paste0(0,ZIP),
      str_length(ZIP)==3~paste0(0,0,ZIP),
    ))%>%
    group_by(ZIP)%>%
    summarize(TotalDialysisCentersZIP=n(), 
              TotalDialysisStationsZIP=sum(TOTSTAS),
              TotalProfitDialysisCentersZIP=sum(PROFIT_STATUS=="Profit"),
              TotalProfitDialysisStationsZIP=sum(TOTSTAS[PROFIT_STATUS=="Profit"]),
              TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersZIP=sum(PROFIT_STATUS=="Non-Profit"),
              TotNonProfitDialysisStationsZIP=sum(TOTSTAS[PROFIT_STATUS=="Non-Profit"])
              )%>%
    return()
}

#Define input function for TXT
dialysis_read_txt<-function(x) {
  read_delim(x, "\t", escape_double = FALSE, col_types = cols(phyzip = col_character()), trim_ws = TRUE) %>%
    rename_with(toupper)%>%
    rename(ZIP= PHYZIP)%>%
    rename(PROFIT_STATUS=OWNTYPE)%>%
    select(ZIP, TOTSTAS, PROFIT_STATUS)%>%
    mutate(ZIP=case_when(
      str_length(ZIP)==5~ZIP,
      str_length(ZIP)==4~paste0(0,ZIP),
      str_length(ZIP)==3~paste0(0,0,ZIP),
    ))%>%
    group_by(ZIP)%>%
    summarize(TotalDialysisCentersZIP=n(), 
              TotalDialysisStationsZIP=sum(TOTSTAS),
              TotalProfitDialysisCentersZIP=sum(PROFIT_STATUS==1),
              TotalProfitDialysisStationsZIP=sum(TOTSTAS[PROFIT_STATUS==1]),
              TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersZIP=sum(PROFIT_STATUS==2),
              TotNonProfitDialysisStationsZIP=sum(TOTSTAS[PROFIT_STATUS==2])
              )%>%
    return()
}

#Create data list of CSV files
data_csv_clean<-File_List_csv_clean%>%
  mutate(file_contents = map(FileName,~dialysis_read_csv(.)))

#Create data list of TXT files
data_txt_clean<-File_List_txt_clean%>%
  mutate(file_contents = map(FileName,~dialysis_read_txt(.)))

#Combine data
data_combined_clean<-bind_rows(data_csv_clean, data_txt_clean)%>%
  #Create a variable which stores the year
  mutate(Year=str_extract(FileName, "20[0-9][0-9]"))%>%
  #Create temp var which stores time as 4 digit year, 2 digit month, 2 digit day if filename uses this format
  mutate(time=parse_number(FileName))%>%
  mutate(time=ifelse(time>10000,time,NA))%>%
  mutate(time=as.character(time))%>%
  #Create a variable which stores the month
  mutate(Month=ifelse(is.na(time), str_extract(FileName, "_[0-1][0-9]_"), str_sub(time,5,6) ))%>%
  mutate(Month=parse_number(Month))%>%
  #Create a variable which stores the day of month; assume first of the month for more recent years
  mutate(Day=ifelse(is.na(time), 1, str_sub(time,7,8) ))%>%
  #Create a DateStart variable:
  mutate(DateStart=paste0(Year,"-",Month,"-",Day))%>%
  mutate(DateStart=as.Date(DateStart))%>%
  select(-time, -Year, -Month, -Day)%>%
  arrange(DateStart)%>%
  mutate(DateEnd=lead(DateStart)-1)%>%
  filter(!is.na(DateEnd))%>%
  #Expand data set based on duration
  mutate(Duration=DateEnd-DateStart+1)%>%
  mutate(Duration=as.numeric((Duration)))%>%
  uncount(Duration)%>%
  group_by(FileName)%>%
  mutate(N=row_number()-1)%>%
  mutate(DateCurrent=N+DateStart)%>%
  ungroup
  
  
  
#Unnest data
data_combined_clean_unnested<-data_combined_clean%>%
  unnest(cols=file_contents)%>%
  arrange(ZIP, DateCurrent)%>%
  select(-N, -DateStart, -DateEnd, -FileName)
  
#Remove unneeded files
rm(data_combined_clean)
gc()
  
```

```{r}
#Import and clean USRDS data

#First, we import data from the Medical Evidence Form
medevid_raw <- read_sas("<data folder>/medevid.sas7bdat", NULL)%>%
  select(RACE, ETHN, MEFDATE, SEX, DIALDAT, SERCR, TDATE, WEIGHT, HEIGHT, PROVUSRD, USRDS_ID, INC_AGE, GFR_MDRD, 
         GFR_EPI, DIALSET, DIALTYP, NEPHCARE, NEPHCARERANGE, PDIS, CDTYPE, ALBUM, HEGLB, 
         ACCESSTYPE, AVFMATURING, AVGMATURING, starts_with("MEDCOV"), starts_with("COMO"))%>%
  arrange(USRDS_ID, MEFDATE)%>%
  group_by(USRDS_ID)%>%
  mutate(N=row_number())%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(Year=year(MEFDATE))%>%
  mutate(RACE=factor(RACE,
         levels=c("1","11","2","3","4","41","5","6","9"),
         labels=c("White","MidEast","Black","Native American","Asian","South Asian",
         "Pacific Islander","Other","Unknown")))%>%
#Define a Hispanic ethnicity variable
    mutate(HISPANIC=factor(ETHN,
         levels=c("1","2","3","5","9"),
         labels=c("Hispanic","Hispanic","Non-Hispanic","Hispanic","Unknown")
         ))%>%
  select(-ETHN)%>%
#Create factor variables for whether pt had nephrology care or not
  mutate(NEPHCARE=factor(NEPHCARE,
         levels=c("1","2","9"),
         labels=c("Nephrology care","No nephrology care","Unknown")
         ))%>%
  mutate(NEPHCARERANGE=ifelse(NEPHCARE=="No nephrology care","99",NEPHCARERANGE))%>%
  mutate(NEPHCARERANGE=factor(NEPHCARERANGE,
         levels=c("0","1","2", "99"),
         labels=c("< 6 months","6-12 months","> 12 months", "None")
         ))%>%
#Create labelled factor variable for access type
  mutate(ACCESSTYPE=ifelse(ACCESSTYPE==5, NA, ACCESSTYPE))%>%
  mutate(
    ACCESSTYPE=factor(ACCESSTYPE,
         levels=c("1","2","3", "4"),
         labels=c("AVF","AVG","Catheter", "Other")
         )
  )%>%
#Create labelled factor variables for presence of fistula/graft at time of HD initiation
  mutate(AVFMATURING=ifelse(AVFMATURING==9, NA, AVFMATURING))%>%
  mutate(
    AVFMATURING=factor(AVFMATURING,
         levels=c("1","2"),
         labels=c("Yes","No")
         )
  )%>%
  
  mutate(AVGMATURING=ifelse(AVGMATURING==9, NA, AVGMATURING))%>%
  mutate(
    AVGMATURING=factor(AVGMATURING,
         levels=c("1","2"),
         labels=c("Yes","No")
         )
  )%>%
  
  #Create variable based on insurance status
  mutate(INSURANCESTATUS=case_when(
    MEDCOV_NONE=="Y"~"No insurance",
    MEDCOV_MDCD=="Y"~"Medicaid/Dual eligible/Managed Medicaid",
    MEDCOV_MDCR=="Y"~"Medicare/managed Medicare",
    MEDCOV_ADVANTAGE=="Y"~"Medicare/managed Medicare",
    MEDCOV_GROUP=="Y"~"Commercial",
    MEDCOV_DVA=="Y"~"Other",
    MEDCOV_OTHER=="Y"~"Other"
  ))%>%
  
  
#Convert a number of factor variables
  mutate(SEX=as.factor(SEX))%>%
  mutate(DIALSET=as.factor(DIALSET))%>%
  mutate(DIALTYP=as.factor(DIALTYP))%>%
  mutate(CDTYPE=as.factor(CDTYPE))%>%
  mutate(PROVUSRD=as.factor(PROVUSRD))%>%
  mutate(INSURANCESTATUS=as.factor(INSURANCESTATUS))%>%
  mutate(across(.cols = starts_with("MEDCOV"),
                .fns = factor
                ))%>%
  mutate(across(.cols = starts_with("COMO_"),
                .fns = factor
                ))%>%
  
#Create dichotomous variable for GFR
  mutate(GFR_DICH=case_when(
    GFR_EPI<10~0,
    GFR_EPI>=10~1,
    is.na(GFR_EPI)~NA_real_
  ))
```

CONSORT statement flowchart--count patients who meet criteria, then remove them.
The CONSORT_statement df contains the number of pts retained and removed in each step

```{r}

#Count total number of patients in medical evidence form
medevid_raw%>%
  count()
CONSORT_statement<-tibble(
  step="Count total number of patients in medical evidence form",
  beginning_number=NA_integer_,
  number_removed=NA_integer_,
  ending=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull())
)

#Remove pts who are on second or greater dialysis episodes
medevid_raw%>%
  count(N>1)
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove pts who are on second or greater dialysis episodes",
  beginning_number=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(medevid_raw%>%filter(N>1)%>%count%>%pull()),
  ending=(medevid_raw%>%filter(N==1)%>%count()%>%pull())
)
medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
  filter(N==1)%>%
  select(-N)
  
#Remove patients who start dialysis prior to 2011
medevid_raw%>%
  count(Year<=2010)
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove patients who start dialysis prior to 2011",
  beginning_number=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(medevid_raw%>%filter(Year<=2010)%>%count%>%pull()),
  ending=(medevid_raw%>%filter(Year>2010)%>%count()%>%pull())
)
medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
  filter(Year>2010)

#Remove patients under age 18 at start of HD
medevid_raw%>%
  count(INC_AGE<18)
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove patients under age 18 at start of HD",
  beginning_number=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(medevid_raw%>%filter(INC_AGE<18)%>%count%>%pull()),
  ending=(medevid_raw%>%filter(INC_AGE>=18)%>%count()%>%pull())
)
medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
  filter(INC_AGE>=18)

#Remove patients not receiving HD
medevid_raw%>%
  count(DIALTYP!=1)
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove patients not receiving HD",
  beginning_number=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(medevid_raw%>%filter(DIALTYP!=1)%>%count%>%pull()),
  ending=(medevid_raw%>%filter(DIALTYP==1)%>%count()%>%pull())
)
medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
  filter(DIALTYP==1)

#Remove patients receiving home HD:
medevid_raw%>%
  count(!(DIALSET==1|DIALSET==2))
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove patients receiving home HD",
  beginning_number=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(medevid_raw%>%filter(!(DIALSET==1|DIALSET==2))%>%count%>%pull()),
  ending=(medevid_raw%>%filter(DIALSET==1|DIALSET==2)%>%count()%>%pull())
)
medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
  filter(DIALSET==1|DIALSET==2)

#Remove patients with no prior Nephrology care (note: we are de-activating this code)
#medevid_raw%>%
  #count(NEPHCARE=="No nephrology care")
#medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
 # filter(!(NEPHCARE=="No nephrology care"))

#Remove patients with missing prior Nephrology care  (note: we are de-activating this code)
#medevid_raw%>%
  #count(NEPHCARE=="Unknown")
#medevid_raw%>%
  #count(is.na(NEPHCARE))
#medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
  #filter(!(NEPHCARE=="Unknown"))

#Remove patients who are neither white nor black  (note: we are de-activating this code)
#medevid_raw%>%
  #count(!(RACE=="White" | RACE=="Black"))
#medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
  #filter(RACE=="White" | RACE=="Black")

#Remove patients for whom insurance status is missing
medevid_raw%>%
  count(is.na(INSURANCESTATUS))
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove patients for whom insurance status is missing",
  beginning_number=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(medevid_raw%>%filter(is.na(INSURANCESTATUS))%>%count%>%pull()),
  ending=(medevid_raw%>%filter(!(is.na(INSURANCESTATUS)))%>%count()%>%pull())
)
medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
  filter(!(is.na(INSURANCESTATUS)))

#Remove patients for whom access type is missing
medevid_raw%>%
  count(is.na(ACCESSTYPE))
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove patients for whom access type is missing",
  beginning_number=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(medevid_raw%>%filter(is.na(ACCESSTYPE))%>%count%>%pull()),
  ending=(medevid_raw%>%filter(!(is.na(ACCESSTYPE)))%>%count()%>%pull())
)
medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
  filter(!(is.na(ACCESSTYPE)))

#Remove patients for whom SEX is missing
medevid_raw%>%
  count(SEX=="U")
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove patients for whom SEX is missing",
  beginning_number=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(medevid_raw%>%filter(SEX=="U")%>%count%>%pull()),
  ending=(medevid_raw%>%filter(!(SEX=="U"))%>%count()%>%pull())
)
medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
  filter(!(SEX=="U"))

#Remove patients for whom GFR>20 is missing
medevid_raw%>%
  count(GFR_EPI>20)
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove patients for whom GFR<20",
  beginning_number=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(medevid_raw%>%filter(GFR_EPI>20)%>%count%>%pull()),
  ending=(medevid_raw%>%filter(!(GFR_EPI>20))%>%count()%>%pull())
)
medevid_raw<-medevid_raw%>%
  filter(!(GFR_EPI>20))

#Exclude Alaska and Hawaii later in file
```

```{r}

#Next, we import the ZIP code data
residenc_raw <- read_sas("<data folder>/residenc.sas7bdat", NULL)%>%
  select(USRDS_ID, ZIPCODE, BEGRES, ENDRES, COUNTY, STATE)%>%
  arrange(USRDS_ID, BEGRES)%>%
  group_by(USRDS_ID)%>%
  mutate(N=row_number())

medevid_raw%>%
  count()

#Merge ZIP code and MedEvid files and only keep observations where dialysis start 
MergedUSRDSDataRaw<-inner_join(medevid_raw, residenc_raw, by="USRDS_ID")%>%
  filter(DIALDAT>=BEGRES & DIALDAT<=ENDRES)%>%
  arrange(USRDS_ID)

#Confirm that USRDS_ID remains unique
length(unique(MergedUSRDSDataRaw$USRDS_ID))==length((MergedUSRDSDataRaw$USRDS_ID))

#See number of pts in file after merge
length(MergedUSRDSDataRaw$USRDS_ID)

#Add appropriate row to the CONSORT statement:      
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove patients with no ZIP code in residence file at time of dialysis initiation",
  beginning_number=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(medevid_raw%>%count()%>%pull()-length(MergedUSRDSDataRaw$USRDS_ID)),
  ending=(length(MergedUSRDSDataRaw$USRDS_ID))
)

#Create crosswalk ZIP to ZCTA
ZIP_ZCTA_crosswalk_2010<-zipzcta::zipzcta%>%rename(ZIPCODE=zip)%>%
  select(ZIPCODE, zcta)

#Merge USRDS Raw data with crosswalk
MergedUSRDSDataRaw<-MergedUSRDSDataRaw%>%left_join(ZIP_ZCTA_crosswalk_2010)

#Add appropriate row to the CONSORT statement:      
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove patients whose ZIP code does not correlate with a ZCTA in 2010 census",
  beginning_number=(MergedUSRDSDataRaw%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(filter(MergedUSRDSDataRaw, is.na(zcta))%>%count()%>%pull()),
  ending=(filter(MergedUSRDSDataRaw, !is.na(zcta))%>%count()%>%pull())
)

 
#rm residence_raw and medevid files
rm(residenc_raw)
rm(medevid_raw)
gc()
```

```{r}

#The ZIP codes without dialysis facilities are not in the data_combined_clean_unnested file, so we add them to avoid later problems

#We pull the list of zip codes from the medevidraw file

FullZIPCODEListUSRDS<-MergedUSRDSDataRaw%>%select(ZIPCODE)%>%
  unique()%>%
  rename(ZIP=ZIPCODE)

FullZIPCODEListFacilitiesFile<-data_combined_clean_unnested%>%
  select(ZIP)%>%
  unique()

ZIPCodesToAddDF<-setdiff(FullZIPCODEListUSRDS, FullZIPCODEListFacilitiesFile)

data_combined_clean_unnested<-data_combined_clean_unnested%>%bind_rows(ZIPCodesToAddDF)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  complete(ZIP, DateCurrent)%>%
  filter(ZIP!="")%>%
  filter(!is.na(DateCurrent))%>%
  arrange(ZIP, DateCurrent)%>%
  #Introduce ZIP code lagged variable
  group_by(ZIP)%>%
  mutate(oneyrlagTotalDialysisCentersZIP = lag(TotalDialysisCentersZIP, n=365, order_by=ZIP))%>%
  mutate(oneyrlagTotalDialysisStationsZIP = lag(TotalDialysisStationsZIP, n=365, order_by=ZIP))%>%
  
  #Fill in missing values for "Total Dialysis Centers"
  mutate(TotalDialysisCentersZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotalDialysisCentersZIP),0,TotalDialysisCentersZIP))%>%
  mutate(TotalDialysisStationsZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotalDialysisStationsZIP),0,TotalDialysisStationsZIP))%>%
  mutate(TotalProfitDialysisCentersZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotalProfitDialysisCentersZIP),0,TotalProfitDialysisCentersZIP))%>%
  mutate(TotalProfitDialysisStationsZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotalProfitDialysisStationsZIP),0,TotalProfitDialysisStationsZIP))%>%
  mutate(TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersZIP),0,TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersZIP))%>%
  mutate(TotNonProfitDialysisStationsZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotNonProfitDialysisStationsZIP),0,TotNonProfitDialysisStationsZIP))

gc()
```

```{r importdxcodes}
#We define the function that pulls the ICD_categories from a spreadsheet
get_dialysis_cause<-function(ICD_category) {
read_excel("<data folder>/dialysis project medevid_dx_codes_2021-11-25.xlsx", 
    sheet = ICD_category)%>%
  return()
}

#Actually pull ICD categories from spreadsheet
Dialysis_Cause_DF<-tibble(DialysisCause=c("Diabetes","Hypertensive and Cardiac", "Glomerulonephritis", 
                                          "HereditaryPCKD", "Transplant", "Other"))%>%
  mutate(ICD_data=map(DialysisCause,get_dialysis_cause))%>%
  unnest(cols = c(ICD_data))%>%
  select(DialysisCause, ICD)%>%
#Remove duplicate rows
  distinct()
```

```{r importacsdata}


#Define input function for ACS
dialysis_get_ACS<-function(y) {
get_acs(geography = "zcta", 
        variables = c(ZIPTotalPopulation = "S0601_C01_001",
                      ZIPPercentageFemale="S0601_C01_012",
                      ZIPPercentageWhite="S0601_C01_014",
                      ZIPPercentageBlack="S0601_C01_015",
                      ZIPPercentageAsian="S0601_C01_017",
                      ZIPPercentageHispanic="S0601_C01_021",
                      ZIPMedianIncome="S0601_C01_047",
                      ZIPPercentagePoverty="S0601_C01_049"
                      ), 
        year=y)%>%
  mutate(ZIP=str_sub(NAME,7,11))%>%
  select(-moe,-NAME, -GEOID)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from=estimate)%>%
  arrange(ZIP)%>%
  return()
}


if (file.exists("<data folder>/acs_raw.rds")) {
  acs_raw <- readRDS("<data folder>/acs_raw.rds")
} else {
#Import and clean ACS data
#First, we create a list of the years we are conducting the study (2011-2019)
acs_raw<-tibble(Year=seq(2011,2019))%>%
  #This next step runs the dialysis_get_ACS function from above for every year above, creating a nested data list
  mutate(ACS_data = map(Year,dialysis_get_ACS))%>%
  #Unnest the data set to create a data set that we can merge with the USRDS based on Year and ZIP
  unnest(ACS_data)%>%
  rename(ZIPCODE=ZIP)
  saveRDS(acs_raw, "<data folder>/acs_raw.rds")
}

gc()
```

```{r}

#Import HSA to ZIP crosswalks, obtained from https://data.dartmouthatlas.org/supplemental/#crosswalks

#Create list of files from 2011 to 2019 and save as a data frame:
File_List_HSA_raw<-list.files(path="<data folder>/HSA Crosswalks", pattern="xls", recursive = TRUE)%>%
  tibble(filepathHSA=paste0("<data folder>/HSA Crosswalks/", .))%>%
  select(filepathHSA)

#Define import function:
HSA_read_xls<-function(x) {
read_xls(x)%>%
    select(starts_with("zipcode"), hsanum)%>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("zipcode"),
      names_to = "year",
      names_prefix = "zipcode",
      values_to = "zipcode"
    )%>%
    mutate(year=as.numeric(year))%>%
    mutate(year=2000+year)%>%
    mutate(zipcode=as.character(zipcode))%>%
    mutate(zipcode=case_when(
      nchar(zipcode)==3~paste0("00",zipcode),
      nchar(zipcode)==4~paste0("0",zipcode),
      nchar(zipcode)==5~zipcode))%>%
    
    
    return
  
}


#Run functions that import HSA files
data_HSA_raw<-File_List_HSA_raw%>%
  mutate(file_contents = map(filepathHSA,~HSA_read_xls(.)))%>%
  unnest(c=(file_contents))%>%
  select(-filepathHSA)%>%
  rename(Year=year)%>%
  rename(ZIPCODE=zipcode)

#Take ACS file and use it to calculate HSA-level population
data_HSA_clean<-acs_raw%>%
  select(Year, ZIPCODE, ZIPTotalPopulation)%>%
  right_join(data_HSA_raw)%>%
  group_by(Year, hsanum)%>%
  mutate(HSATotalPopulation=sum(ZIPTotalPopulation, na.rm = TRUE))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  select(-ZIPTotalPopulation)

gc()

#Take facility unnested file and merge with HSA file to calculate HSA level variables

data_combined_clean_unnested<-data_combined_clean_unnested%>%
  mutate(Year=year(DateCurrent))%>%
  left_join(data_HSA_raw, by=c("ZIP"="ZIPCODE", "Year"))

gc()
  
#Add HSA level variables
  data_combined_clean_unnested<-data_combined_clean_unnested%>%
  group_by(hsanum, DateCurrent)%>%
    mutate(TotalDialysisCentersHSA=sum(TotalDialysisCentersZIP, na.rm = TRUE), 
              TotalDialysisStationsHSA=sum(TotalDialysisStationsZIP, na.rm = TRUE),
              TotalProfitDialysisCentersHSA=sum(TotalProfitDialysisCentersZIP, na.rm = TRUE),
              TotalProfitDialysisStationsHSA=sum(TotalProfitDialysisStationsZIP, na.rm = TRUE),
              TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersHSA=sum(TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersZIP, na.rm = TRUE),
              TotNonProfitDialysisStationsHSA=sum(TotNonProfitDialysisStationsZIP, na.rm = TRUE))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("HSA"), ~ifelse(is.na(hsanum), NA, .x)))

gc()
```

```{r merges}
#Subsequent merges

    anti_join(data_HSA_clean, by=c("ZIPCODE", "Year"))%>%count()%>%pull()),
  ending=((MergedData%>%left_join(Dialysis_Cause_DF, by=c("PDIS"="ICD"))%>% select(-hsanum)%>%
    inner_join(data_HSA_clean, by=c("ZIPCODE", "Year"))%>%count()%>%pull()))
)


MergedData<-MergedData%>%
  left_join(Dialysis_Cause_DF, by=c("PDIS"="ICD"))%>%
  select(-hsanum)%>%
  #Now add HSA variables
  inner_join(data_HSA_clean, by=c("ZIPCODE", "Year"))%>%

  #Create dialysis cause variable and fill in missing values with "Other"
  mutate(DialysisCause=ifelse(is.na(DialysisCause)==TRUE, "Other", DialysisCause))%>%
  mutate(DialysisCause=as.factor(DialysisCause))%>%
  
  #Fill in missing values for "Total Dialysis Centers"
  mutate(TotalDialysisCentersZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotalDialysisCentersZIP),0,TotalDialysisCentersZIP))%>%
  mutate(TotalDialysisStationsZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotalDialysisStationsZIP),0,TotalDialysisStationsZIP))%>%
  mutate(TotalProfitDialysisCentersZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotalProfitDialysisCentersZIP),0,TotalProfitDialysisCentersZIP))%>%
  mutate(TotalProfitDialysisStationsZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotalProfitDialysisStationsZIP),0,TotalProfitDialysisStationsZIP))%>%
  mutate(TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersZIP),0,TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersZIP))%>%
  mutate(TotNonProfitDialysisStationsZIP=ifelse(is.na(TotNonProfitDialysisStationsZIP),0,TotNonProfitDialysisStationsZIP))%>%
  
  #Adjust variables for ZIP code population
  mutate(dcpp=(TotalDialysisCentersZIP/ZIPTotalPopulation)*100000)%>%
  mutate(dcpp1=(TotalDialysisStationsZIP/ZIPTotalPopulation)*100000)%>%
  mutate(dcpp2=(oneyrlagTotalDialysisStationsZIP/ZIPTotalPopulation)*100000)%>%
  
  mutate(dcpp_profit=(TotalProfitDialysisCentersZIP/ZIPTotalPopulation)*100000)%>%
  mutate(dcpp1_profit=(TotalProfitDialysisStationsZIP/ZIPTotalPopulation)*100000)%>%
  
  mutate(dcpp_nonprofit=(TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersZIP/ZIPTotalPopulation)*100000)%>%
  mutate(dcpp1_nonprofit=(TotNonProfitDialysisStationsZIP/ZIPTotalPopulation)*100000)%>%

  
  mutate(stations3_ZIP=case_when(
    dcpp1==0~0,
    dcpp1>0 & dcpp1<=66~1,
    dcpp1>66~2,
    is.na(dcpp1)~NA_real_
  )
         )%>%
  mutate(stations3_ZIP=factor(stations3_ZIP,
                          levels = c(0,1,2),
                          labels = c("0", "Between 0 and 66", "66+")))%>%
  mutate(lag3_ZIP=case_when(

    dcpp2>0 & dcpp2<=114.6~1,

  )

  mutate(lag3_ZIP=factor(lag3_ZIP,

                          labels = c("0", "Between 0 and 114.6", "114.6+")))%>%
  mutate(centers3_ZIP=case_when(

  )

  mutate(centers3_ZIP=factor(centers3_ZIP,
                          levels = c(0,1,2),
                          labels = c("0", "Between 0 and 6.7", "6.7+")))%>%
  
  #HSA variables
  mutate(HSATotalCenterDensity=(TotalDialysisCentersHSA/ HSATotalPopulation)*100000 )%>%
  mutate(HSATotalStationDensity=(TotalDialysisStationsHSA/ HSATotalPopulation)*100000 )%>%
  mutate(HSAProfitCenterDensity=(TotalProfitDialysisCentersHSA/ HSATotalPopulation)*100000 )%>%
  mutate(HSAProfitStationDensity=(TotalProfitDialysisStationsHSA/ HSATotalPopulation)*100000 )%>%
  mutate(HSANonProfitCenterDensity=(TotalNonProfitDialysisCentersHSA/ HSATotalPopulation)*100000 )%>%
  mutate(HSANonProfitStationDensity=(TotNonProfitDialysisStationsHSA/ HSATotalPopulation)*100000 )

  count(is.na(femaleswithonemammointwoyears))

MergedData%>%
  count(is.na(percentwithhgba1c2015))

MergedData%>%
  count(is.na(FTEHospitalEmployeesper1000))

MergedData%>%
  count(is.na(AcuteCareHospitalBedsper10))

rm(hsa_hospitalcapacity)
rm(hsahittingbenchmark)
gc()


#Is there a missing data problem?
MergedData%>%
  anti_join(RUCA2010zipcode_clean, by=c("ZIPCODE"="ZIP_CODE"))%>%
  count()
#Confirm, no missing data for Urban/Rural


#Add code to merge urban/rural
MergedData<-MergedData%>%
  left_join(RUCA2010zipcode_clean, by=c("ZIPCODE"="ZIP_CODE"))

#Remove patients for whom RUCA1 is not coded--this is a code for no pts actually live in this ZIP code
CONSORT_statement<-CONSORT_statement%>%
  add_row(
  step="Remove patients if RUCA is not coded",
  beginning_number=(MergedData%>%count()%>%pull()),
  number_removed=(MergedData%>%filter(RUCA1==11)%>%count()%>%pull()),
  ending=(MergedData%>%filter(RUCA1!=11)%>%count()%>%pull())
)

MergedData<-MergedData%>%
  filter(RUCA1!="Not coded: Census tract has zero population and no rural-urban identifier information")

#Now we create quantiles of some of the variables
HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles<-quantile(MergedData$HSATotalCenterDensity, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
HSATotlCenterDensity_labels<-c("0",
      paste("Nonzero ≤", round(HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[1],2)),
      paste(round(HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[1],2), "to", round(HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[2],2)),
      paste(round(HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[2],2), "to", round(HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[3],2)),
      paste("Greater than",round(HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[3],2)))

HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles<-quantile(MergedData$HSATotalStationDensity, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
HSATotStationDensity_labels<-c("0",
      paste("Nonzero ≤", round(HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[1],2)),
      paste(round(HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[1],2), "to", round(HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[2],2)),
      paste(round(HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[2],2), "to", round(HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[3],2)),
      paste("Greater than",round(HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[3],2)))


MergedData<-MergedData%>%
  mutate(ZIPPercentageBlack_cat=ntile_label(ZIPPercentageBlack,4))%>%
  mutate(ZIPPercentageBlack_cat=factor(ZIPPercentageBlack_cat))%>%
  mutate(HSATotlCenterDensity_categorical=case_when(
    HSATotalCenterDensity==0~0,
    HSATotalCenterDensity>0 & HSATotalCenterDensity<=HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[1]~1,
    HSATotalCenterDensity>HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[1] & HSATotalCenterDensity<=HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[2]~2,
    HSATotalCenterDensity>HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[2] & HSATotalCenterDensity<=HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[3]~3,
    HSATotalCenterDensity>HSATotalCenterDensityQuartiles[3] & !is.na(HSATotalCenterDensity)~4
  ))%>%
  mutate(HSATotlCenterDensity_categorical=factor(HSATotlCenterDensity_categorical,
                                                 levels=c(0,1,2,3,4),
                                                 labels = HSATotlCenterDensity_labels))%>%
  mutate(HSATotStationDensity_categorical=case_when(
    HSATotalStationDensity==0~0,
    HSATotalStationDensity>0 & HSATotalStationDensity<=HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[1]~1,
    HSATotalStationDensity>HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[1] & HSATotalStationDensity<=HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[2]~2,
    HSATotalStationDensity>HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[2] & HSATotalStationDensity<=HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[3]~3,
    HSATotalStationDensity>HSATotalStationDensityQuartiles[3] & !is.na(HSATotalStationDensity)~4
  ))%>%
  mutate(HSATotStationDensity_categorical=factor(HSATotStationDensity_categorical,
                                                 levels=c(0,1,2,3,4),
                                                 labels = HSATotStationDensity_labels))%>%
      

  #And create comorbidity variables:
  mutate(heartfailure=ifelse(COMO_CHF=="Y", 1, 0))%>%
  mutate(cad=ifelse(COMO_ASHD=="Y", 1, 0))%>%
  mutate(diabetes=ifelse(COMO_DM_INS=="Y"|COMO_DM_ORAL=="Y"|COMO_DM_NOMEDS=="Y"|COMO_DM_RET=="Y", 1, 0))%>%
  mutate(cerebrovasc=ifelse(COMO_CVATIA=="Y", 1, 0))%>%
  mutate(alcordrug=ifelse(COMO_ALCHO=="Y"| COMO_DRUG=="Y", 1, 0))%>%
  mutate(immobility=ifelse(COMO_INAMB=="Y"| COMO_NEEDASST=="Y"|COMO_INTRANS =="Y", 1, 0))%>%
  mutate(institution=ifelse(COMO_INST=="Y"|COMO_INST_AL=="Y"|COMO_INST_NURS=="Y"|COMO_INST_OTH=="Y", 1, 0))%>%
  mutate(canceryes=ifelse(COMO_CANC=="Y", 1,0))

#Create a variable which stores the Stata file name
MergedData_name<-paste0("MergedData ",Sys.Date(),".dta")

#Save the merged data set as a Stata file
MergedData%>%
  write_dta(MergedData_name)

#Save the R data set
saveRDS(MergedData, "Merged_data_2023-10-5.RDS")

#Save the consort Excel file
write_xlsx(CONSORT_statement,"CONSORT statement 2023-10-5.xlsx")
```

```{r}
#Note,the same HSA can correspond to different categories of density in different time periods, so we cannot plot at a global level using a beeswarm plot.  We can, however, add these variables to the map and then create a map
MergedData%>%
  group_by(hsanum)%>%
  summarize(HSA_CHF_proportion=mean(heartfailure),
            HSA_CAD_proportion=mean(cad),
            HSA_diabetes_proportion=mean(diabetes),
            HSA_cerebrovasc_proportion=mean(cerebrovasc),
            HSA_alcordrug_proportion=mean(alcordrug),
            HSA_immobility_proportion=mean(immobility),
            HSA_institution_proportion=mean(institution),
            )


#Set up tmap library for interactive html maps
tmap_mode("view")

HSACenterMap<-HSA_short_data_map%>%
  filter(Year==2019)%>%

              style="jenks")
tmap_save(HSACenterMap, "HSA Center Density Interactive Map 2023-10-18.html")
```
